full_article:
Kathmandu, August 18

Nepal made an emphatic start to their preparations for the upcoming ACC Premier Cup, defeating Karnataka by 116 runs in their first practice match in India.

Batting first after winning the toss, Nepal were bowled out for 188 runs in 45 overs.

Aasif Sheikh top-scored for Nepal with 49 runs from 70 balls, hitting two fours and a six. Opener Dev Khanal contributed 27 off 43 balls with five fours, while Ishan Pandey scored 34 off 49 balls, hitting three fours.

Sundeep Jora added 27 off 37 balls with two fours, while Bashir Ahmed remained unbeaten on 19 from 27 balls.

Gulshan Jha scored 11 off 16 balls, while Rohit Paudel made four runs. Karan KC was dismissed without scoring, while captain Sandeep Lamichhane and Sher Malla scored two and one run respectively.

Nepal suffered an early setback when Arjun Kumal was dismissed for a duck after facing four balls. However, Aasif, Dev and Ishan steadied the innings and helped Nepal build a competitive total.

Karnataka’s Keerthi M was the standout bowler, taking five wickets for 20 runs from eight overs. Aditya Goel, Aravind Kumar Rai, Chirant Shivrudra, Sagar Gautam and Samarth Srinivas took one wicket each.

Karnataka collapse for 72

Chasing 189, Karnataka struggled against Nepal’s bowling attack and were bowled out for just 72 runs in 28 overs.

Sharath Srinivas was Karnataka’s top scorer with 32 runs from 65 balls, including three fours. Revanth Bairy scored 10, while Santosh Singh contributed nine.

The rest of Karnataka’s batting line-up failed to make an impact, with Lochan Gowda scoring two, Tushar Singh and Samarth Srinivas dismissed without scoring, and Sanjay Ashwin making one.

Ritesh Bhatkal scored six, Sagar Gautam was dismissed for a duck, Keerthi M made three and Aditya Goel scored six.

For Nepal, Karan KC led the bowling attack, taking two wickets for just nine runs in five overs.

Lalit Rajbanshi, Sher Malla and Bashir Ahmed also took two wickets each, while Sandeep Lamichhane claimed one.

The comprehensive victory gives Nepal a strong start to their warm-up campaign as they continue preparations for the ACC Premier Cup.

ललित राजबंशी, शेर मल्ला आरू बशीर अहमद न॑ भी दू-दू विकेट लेलकै, जबकि संदीप लामिछाने न॑ एक विकेट प॑ दावा करलकै ।

full_article:
Every year, a similar email lands in the inbox of pretty much every Nepal trekking agency: “I want to see Everest, but I’m not sure if I should trek or fly.” It’s a fair question, and honestly, there’s no single right answer. Walking through the Khumbu on the Everest Three High Pass Trek and flying over it on an Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour are two completely different experiences of the same mountain. One asks weeks of your time and a good pair of lungs. The other asks a few hours and a decent weather window. Which one suits you depends on how much time you have, your fitness and altitude tolerance, your budget, and honestly, what kind of story you want to tell when you get home.

There’s also a quieter decision hiding underneath the bigger one — picking the right trekking company in Nepal. Get that part wrong and even the best itinerary can fall apart on the trail.

So here’s the short version, if you’re in a hurry: if you want a serious, immersive Himalayan trekking experience with high mountain passes and days spent among Sherpa villages, the Everest Three High Pass Trek is the one. If your time is limited and you mainly want to see Everest up close without weeks of walking, an Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour will get you there faster, with far less physical strain. Now let’s get into why.

Everest Three High Pass Trek — What the Journey Is Really Like

Most people have heard of the standard Everest Base Camp Trek. The Three High Pass Trek is its bigger, tougher cousin — the version for people who’ve already got a few Himalayan trails under their boots, or who simply want more from the mountains than a straight there-and-back walk. Instead of following one main trail up and down the valley, this route loops through three high mountain passes, stitching together valleys, glacial lakes, and remote settlements that the standard trek never touches.

The Three High Passes

The route is built around three passes, each with its own personality. Kongma La is usually tackled first (or last, depending on direction), and it’s a brutal early test — steep scree, a long ascent, and thin air that makes every step feel heavier than it should. Cho La comes next, often crossed with crampons if there’s snow on the glacier section near the top, and it connects the Everest side of the region to Gokyo. Then there’s Renjo La, which for many trekkers ends up being the emotional high point of the whole trip — the views from the top, weather permitting, stretch across a jaw-dropping sweep of eight-thousanders. Together, these three passes turn the trek into something closer to a circuit than a corridor, weaving through remote valleys and traditional Sherpa settlements most standard itineraries skip entirely.

What Travelers See Along the Way

The scenery doesn’t stay the same for two days in a row, which is part of what makes this trek special. Early on, you’re walking under Ama Dablam’s unmistakable spire, through pine forest and past prayer flags strung between villages. Higher up, the landscape turns stark and lunar, with Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, and Makalu all visible at different points depending on where the trail bends. The detour to Gokyo Lakes adds a completely different flavor — turquoise water against grey moraine, with Gokyo Ri offering arguably better views than Kala Patthar on a clear day. And of course, there’s still Everest Base Camp itself and the walk up Kala Patthar at dawn, plus long stretches alongside the Khumbu Glacier, its ice towers jutting up like something out of another planet. It’s this variety, more than any single viewpoint, that makes Everest region trekking on the three-pass route feel so different from a straightforward walk to base camp. This is high-altitude trekking in its fullest sense — not just one big push to a famous spot, but days and days of shifting terrain, weather, and mood.

Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour — Who Is It Best For?

Not everyone has three weeks free, and not everyone wants to spend three weeks walking uphill in the cold — and that’s completely fine. The Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour exists for exactly that traveler, and it shouldn’t be dismissed as some watered-down version of “the real thing.” It’s its own experience.

Typically, the trip starts with an early flight out of Kathmandu, cutting straight into the Everest region rather than relying on the usual Lukla flight. From there, the helicopter usually stops at Everest Base Camp or nearby for photos, sometimes continuing on to a viewpoint near Kala Patthar, before landing in Namche or Syangboche for tea, a bit of oxygen adjustment, and those postcard views of the Himalayas from a lodge terrace. The whole thing is often done in a single morning. It’s genuinely one of the more efficient ways to see this part of the world — you get sweeping aerial scenery, a landing at (or near) base camp itself, and you’re back in Kathmandu in time for lunch. That said, it’s just as weather-dependent as everything else in these mountains, sometimes more so, since low cloud or high wind can ground flights entirely.

Who tends to book this? Travelers with limited vacation time, older visitors who’d rather not commit to multi-day high-altitude trekking, people with health considerations that make prolonged trekking risky, and honestly, plenty of trekkers who’ve already done Everest Base Camp on foot once and just want another look without doing it all again. It’s worth being upfront, though: an Everest helicopter tour and a multi-week trek through the Khumbu are not interchangeable experiences. You don’t get the villages, the slow acclimatization, the conversations with tea house owners, or the sense of having earned the view. What you get instead is Everest Base Camp by helicopter — fast, dramatic, and a lot less punishing on the knees.

Everest Three High Pass Trek vs Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour

Factor Three High Pass Trek EBC Helicopter Tour Duration Multi-day (typically 18–21 days) Usually a single-day experience Physical demand Very high Low Altitude exposure Extended, gradual Brief Mountain experience Immersive, on the ground Aerial Main attraction Passes, valleys, villages, and mountains Everest views and aerial scenery Fitness requirement Strong fitness needed Much less demanding Weather dependency Significant Very significant Cultural interaction High Limited Best for Experienced trekkers Time-limited travelers

Numbers on a table only tell part of the story, though. If what you want is challenge — long days of walking, mountain passes underfoot, remote landscapes, and a real feel for how life works in these high valleys — the Three High Pass Trek delivers that in a way nothing else can. But if your priority is simply seeing Everest, and doing it within a tight schedule without days of high-altitude walking, the helicopter tour makes a lot more sense. Neither choice is “better.” They’re just built for different people.

Difficulty, Altitude and Physical Preparation

There’s no sugarcoating it — the Three High Pass route is one of the harder treks in the Everest region, and it’s worth understanding why before you commit. Days are long, some stretching eight or nine hours of walking. Ascents and descents are steep, especially around the passes themselves, and the cold at altitude can be unpredictable even in peak season. Crossing Kongma La, Cho La, and Renjo La back-to-back within a single itinerary asks a lot of your body, particularly your legs and your lungs.

Acclimatization isn’t optional here — it’s built into the whole logic of the trek. Gaining altitude gradually, with rest days scheduled at key points, is what keeps most trekkers safe and functioning. Beyond that, a decent baseline of cardiovascular fitness helps enormously, as does some hiking practice on hilly terrain before you fly out. Good boots that are already broken in, proper layered clothing, staying hydrated, and — this one gets skipped more than it should — actually listening to your guide if they mention altitude symptoms, all matter more than people expect. If you’ve got any underlying health concerns, it’s worth having a conversation with a doctor before booking anything at this altitude.

Best Time for Everest Trekking and Helicopter Tours

Spring

March to May is a favorite for a reason. Days warm up, rhododendrons bloom lower in the valley, and mountain visibility tends to be good. It’s also one of the busier windows, so expect company on the trail and in tea houses.

Autumn

September through November is arguably the strongest trekking period of the year. Skies are usually clear, temperatures are manageable, and this is when the majority of international trekkers show up.

Winter and Monsoon

Winter brings genuinely tough conditions at the high passes — biting cold, occasional snow closures, and shorter daylight. Monsoon season, meanwhile, tends to bring cloud cover, rain lower down, and frequent flight delays. And this is worth repeating: helicopter tours are not weather-proof. Low visibility or strong wind can ground flights just as easily as it can cancel a Lukla flight, so don’t treat the helicopter option as some kind of guaranteed backup plan.

Permits, Flights, Accommodation and What the Cost Usually Depends On

Before setting foot in the Khumbu, there’s paperwork — entry into Sagarmatha National Park requires a permit, and depending on your route, local trekking permits may apply as well. Most trekkers fly into Lukla to begin, staying in tea houses along the way, with meals typically included as part of the package. Guides and porters are close to essential on the Three High Pass route given the terrain, and travel insurance covering high-altitude trekking (and helicopter evacuation, ideally) is something no one should skip.

Rather than throwing out a fixed price that’ll be outdated within a year, it’s more honest to say that cost depends on quite a few moving parts — the season you travel in, group size, how many days the trek runs, whether you’re hiring private guides and porters or joining a group, the standard of tea house accommodation, and for the helicopter option, availability and whether you’re sharing the flight or booking it privately. Anyone quoting you an exact number without asking these questions first is skipping a step.

How to Choose a Trekking Company in Nepal

This is where a lot of trips quietly go wrong, and it rarely has anything to do with the mountain.

Check Legal and Professional Credentials

Look for proper registration, guides with real experience on the specific route you’re doing, the right trekking permissions sorted out on their end, clear and reachable company information, and a real answer when you ask what happens in an emergency. If a company gets vague on that last point, that’s a red flag worth taking seriously.

Look Beyond the Cheapest Package

The lowest price on the page rarely tells the whole story. What’s actually included? What’s not? Are guides properly trained, are porters treated fairly and equipped for the cold, is accommodation what was promised, and does the company communicate clearly before and during the trip — not just when you’re paying, but when something goes sideways with weather or health. These are the questions that separate a good trekking agency in Nepal from one that’s just good at marketing.

Read Reviews Carefully

One glowing five-star review means very little on its own. Look for patterns across many reviews instead — comments on guide professionalism, how the company communicated, how they handled safety situations, whether pricing matched what was promised, and how they responded when flights got delayed or plans changed last minute. Real traveler experiences, especially the messy ones, tell you more than polished testimonials ever will. This is really the core of finding the best trekking company in Nepal — patterns over polish, and licensed trekking guides over the cheapest bid.

What Makes a Reliable Everest Trekking Operator?

A genuinely competent operator won’t just sell you a package — they’ll explain it. Ask about the itinerary and how acclimatization is built into it, altitude risks, permit requirements, what happens if weather disrupts the plan, emergency procedures, insurance expectations, equipment you’ll need to bring versus what they provide, guide qualifications, and — if relevant — helicopter evacuation or contingency arrangements. Rather than chasing whoever claims to be “the best,” it’s more useful to learn what a competent operator actually sounds like when they answer your questions. That’s a much better filter than any star rating.

What to Pack for Either Everest Experience

For the Three High Pass Trek, pack for real cold and real distance: solid trekking boots, warm layers, a good down jacket, gloves, sunglasses, sun protection, a reusable water bottle, a headlamp, a sleeping bag rated for sub-zero nights, any personal medication, and basic first-aid supplies.

For the helicopter tour, the list shrinks considerably — warm clothing for the cold at altitude even during a short stop, sunglasses, your camera or phone charged and ready, identification and travel documents, and travel insurance. Because one trip runs for weeks and the other for hours, it makes sense that what you carry looks almost nothing alike.

When Each Option Makes More Sense

Go with the Everest Three High Pass Trek if you’ve got the time, you genuinely enjoy a physical challenge, you want to cross real Himalayan passes, and you’re after deeper interaction with the Khumbu’s landscape and its villages — where the journey itself becomes the point of the trip.

Go with the Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour if your time is limited, you want mountain views without weeks of walking, you’d prefer something with lower physical demand, and you’re comfortable with the fact that weather might shift your schedule around a little.

A Note on Choosing an Experienced Local Operator

When comparing established operators in the region, it helps to look at things like guide experience, how transparent the itinerary is, how safety is planned for, and how well they actually know the Everest region on the ground. Companies such as Adventure Great Himalaya come up in these conversations precisely because travelers tend to weigh operators against exactly these criteria — not against flashy marketing, but against real, checkable experience.

Final Thoughts — Pick the Everest Experience That Fits You

At the end of the day, the Everest Three High Pass Trek is about challenge, immersion, and days spent moving through a landscape that keeps changing under your boots. The Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour is about speed, convenience, and getting those unforgettable aerial views of the Himalayas without weeks away from home. Neither one is the “correct” choice — they’re just answers to different questions.

Whichever way you go, the quality of the trekking company in Nepal you choose will shape the whole experience more than people expect. Before booking, compare itineraries, inclusions, safety arrangements, guide experience, weather policies, and total cost side by side. A good operator should be willing to walk you through all of it clearly, rather than just pushing you toward a sale.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Everest Three High Pass Trek harder than Everest Base Camp Trek?

Yes, noticeably so. The three-pass route adds Kongma La, Cho La, and Renjo La into the mix, which means more elevation gain, tougher terrain, and longer days compared to the standard Everest Base Camp Trek.

Is the Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour worth it?

For travelers with limited time or lower physical capacity, it often is — you get to see Everest and the surrounding peaks up close without the physical toll of trekking. Just keep in mind it’s heavily weather-dependent, so flexibility around your schedule helps.

Which is better, Everest Three High Pass Trek or helicopter tour?

It really comes down to who’s asking. Trekkers wanting immersion, challenge, and time in the mountains will prefer the three-pass route. Travelers short on time or looking for a lower-impact way to see Everest will likely get more out of the helicopter tour.

How do I choose a trekking company in Nepal?

Check their registration and permits, look into guide experience and qualifications, ask about safety procedures and emergency support, make sure pricing is transparent, and read a range of reviews rather than just the top few.

त, एतय छोट संस्करण, जं जल्दी हो तं : जं ऊँच पहाड़ी दर्रा आ शेर्पा गामक बीच बिताओल दिनक संग गंभीर, विसर्जनशील हिमालयन ट्रेकिंग अनुभव चाहैत छी तं एवरेस्ट थ्री हाई दर्रा ट्रेक थिक. जं समय सीमित अछि आ मुख्यतः बिना हफ्ताक पैदल यात्रा केने एवरेस्ट कें नजदीक सं देखय चाहैत छी तं एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप हेलीकॉप्टर टूर सं ओतय तेजी सं पहुंचि जायत, जाहि में शारीरिक तनाव कहीं कम होयत. आब किएक एहि पर आबि जाउ।

एवरेस्ट थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक — यात्रा वास्तव में केहन अछि |

बेसी लोक मानक एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप ट्रेक के नाम सुनने हेताह. थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक एकर पैघ, कठोर पितियौत भाइ थिक — एहन लोकक संस्करण जे पहिने सं बूटक नीचा किछु हिमालयी पगडंडी भ’ गेल होइछ, वा जे बस सीधा ओतय-पाछू टहलबा सं बेसी पहाड़ सं बेसी चाहैत छथि. घाटी में ऊपर-नीचा एकटा मुख्य पगडंडी पर चलबाक बदला ई मार्ग तीन टा ऊँच पहाड़ी दर्रा सं लूप करैत अछि, घाटी, हिमनदी झील आ दूरस्थ बस्ती सब कें एक दोसरा सं सिलाई करैत अछि जकरा मानक पदयात्रा कहियो नहिं छूबैत अछि.

तीन हाई पास

ई मार्ग तीन पास के आसपास बनल छै, जेकरऽ हर पास के अपनऽ व्यक्तित्व छै । कोंगमा ला कें आमतौर पर पहिने (वा अंतिम, दिशाक आधार पर) टैकल कयल जाइत छैक, आ ई एकटा क्रूर प्रारंभिक परीक्षा थिक — खड़ी स्क्री, लंबा चढ़ाई, आ पतली हवा जे हर डेग कें जतेक भारी बुझाइत छैक, ओहि सं बेसी भारी बुझाइत छैक. आगू चो ला अबैत अछि, जं चोटी लग ग्लेशियर खंड पर बर्फ हो तं प्रायः क्रैम्पन सं पार कयल जाइत अछि, आ ई एहि क्षेत्रक एवरेस्ट कात कें गोक्यो सं जोड़ैत अछि. तखन रेंजो ला, जे बहुतो ट्रेकर्स ले अंततः पूरा यात्राक भावनात्मक उच्च बिन्दु थिक — ऊपर सं दृश्य, मौसमक अनुमति, आठ-हजारक जबड़ा-ड्रॉपिंग स्वीप पर पसरल. ई तीनू पास मिल क ट्रेक कें गलियारा सं बेसी सर्किट सं नजदीक किछु में बदलि दैत अछि, दूरस्थ घाटी आ पारंपरिक शेर्पा बस्तीक बीच सं बुनैत अधिकांश मानक यात्रा कार्यक्रम पूर्णतः छोड़ि दैत अछि.

रास्ता मे यात्री की देखैत छथि

लगातार दू दिन धरि दृश्य एक समान नहिं रहैत छैक, जे एहि ट्रेक कें विशेष बनेबाक एकटा हिस्सा थिक. शुरू में, अहाँ आमा डब्लम’क अचूक शिखरक नीचा, पाइन जंगल आ गाम-गामक बीच तारल बीतल प्रार्थनाक झंडा सं गुजरैत छी. ऊपर में ई परिदृश्य शुद्ध आ चंद्रमा के रूप में बदलै छै, जेकरा में एवरेस्ट, ल्होत्से, नुप्ट्से, आरू मकालू सब अलग-अलग बिंदु पर दिखाई दै छै, ई बात के आधार पर कि निशान कतय झुकै छै. गोक्यो झील केरऽ चक्कर में एकदम अलग स्वाद आबै छै — ग्रे मोरेन के विरुद्ध फ़िरोज़ा पानी, जेकरा में गोक्यो री केरऽ साफ दिन में काला पत्थर स॑ यकीनन बेहतर दृश्य देखै ल॑ मिलै छै । आ अवश्य, एखनो स्वयं एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप आ भोर में काला पत्थर पर पैदल चलब, आओर खुम्बू ग्लेशियरक कात में लंबा-लंबा, ओकर बर्फक टावर सब कोनो आन ग्रह सं बाहर निकलल किछु जकाँ उभड़ल. कोनो एक दृष्टिकोण सं बेसी, ई विविधता थिक, जे एवरेस्ट क्षेत्रक तीन पासक मार्ग पर ट्रेकिंग कें बेस कैंप धरि सीधा पैदल यात्रा सं एतेक भिन्न बुझाइत छैक. ई अपन पूर्ण अर्थमें उच्च ऊँचाई पर ट्रेकिंग थिक — कोनो प्रसिद्ध स्थान पर एकटा पैघ धक्का नहिं, अपितु दिन-दिनक बदलैत इलाका, मौसम, आ मनोदशा.

एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप हेलीकॉप्टर टूर — ई केकरा लेल बेस्ट अछि ?

सबहक तीन सप्ताह मुफ्त नहिं छैक, आ सब कियो ठंढा में तीन सप्ताह ऊपर चढ़ैत नहिं बिताबय चाहैत छथि — आ से एकदम ठीक. एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप हेलीकॉप्टर टूर ठीक ओहि यात्रीक लेल मौजूद अछि, आ एकरा “असली चीज” केर कोनो पानि-पानि संस्करणक रूप में खारिज नहिं करबाक चाही. ई त’ अपन अनुभव छैक।

सामान्यतः, यात्रा काठमांडू सं बाहर जल्दी उड़ान सं शुरू होइत अछि, जे सामान्य लुकला उड़ान पर निर्भर नहिं, सीधा एवरेस्ट क्षेत्र में कटौती करैत अछि. ओतय सं हेलीकॉप्टर प्रायः एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप वा लगहिं में फोटो लेबय लेल रुकि जाइत अछि, कखनो काल काला पठारक समीप कोनो व्यूपॉइंट पर आगू बढ़ैत अछि, चाह पीबय, कनेक ऑक्सीजन एडजस्टमेंट, आ लॉजक छत सं हिमालयक ओ पोस्टकार्ड दृश्यक लेल नामचे वा स्यांगबोचे में उतरबा सं पहिने. पूरा काज प्रायः एकहि भोर मे भ' जाइत अछि। ई वास्तव में दुनियाक एहि भागकें देखबाक बेसी कुशल तरीकामें सं एक थिक — व्यापक हवाई दृश्य भेटत, स्वयं बेस कैंपमें (वा लगहिं में) लैंडिंग भेटत, आ भोजनक हेतु समयमें काठमांडू वापस आबि जाइछ. कहल गेल अछि, ई ओतबे मौसम पर निर्भर अछि जतेक एहि पहाड़ सबहक आन सब किछु, कखनो काल बेसी, कारण कम मेघ वा तेज हवा उड़ान कें पूर्ण रूप सं जमीन पर उतारि सकैत अछि.

एकरा बुक करय के प्रवृत्ति के अछि? सीमित छुट्टीक समयक यात्री, वृद्ध आगंतुक जे बहु-दिवसीय उच्च ऊँचाई पर ट्रेकिंगक प्रति प्रतिबद्धता नहिं करब पसिन करैत छथि, स्वास्थ्यक विचार रखनिहार लोक जे लंबा समय धरि ट्रेकिंग कें जोखिम भरल बना दैत छथि, आ ईमानदारी सं, बहुत रास ट्रेकर्स जे एक बेर पैदल एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप क’ चुकल छथि आ बस, बिना फेर सं ई सब केने एकटा आओर नजरि चाहैत छथि. मुदा, ई बात सामने सं कहब लायक अछि : एवरेस्ट हेलीकॉप्टर भ्रमण आ खुम्बू होइत बहु-हफ्ताक ट्रेक एक दोसराक विनिमेय अनुभव नहिं. गाम-घर, धीरे-धीरे अभ्यस्तता, चाह-खाना मालिक सब सं गप्प-सप्प, आ ने दृश्य अर्जित करबाक भाव नहिं भेटैत अछि. एकर बदला में जे भेटत से हेलीकॉप्टर सं एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप — तेज, नाटकीय, आ ठेहुन पर बहुत कम दंडात्मक.

एवरेस्ट थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक बनाम एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप हेलीकॉप्टर टूर

कारक तीन हाई पास ट्रेक ईबीसी हेलीकॉप्टर टूर अवधि बहु-दिन (आम तौर पर 18-21 दिन) आमतौर पर एक दिन के अनुभव भौतिक मांग बहुत अधिक कम ऊंचाई एक्सपोजर विस्तारित, क्रमिक संक्षिप्त पर्वत अनुभव विसर्जनशील, जमीन पर हवाई मुख्य आकर्षण दर्रा, घाटी, गाम, आ पहाड़ एवरेस्ट दृश्य आ हवाई दृश्य फिटनेस के आवश्यकता मजबूत फिटनेस के जरूरत छल Much कम मांग वाला मौसम निर्भरता महत्वपूर्ण बहुत महत्वपूर्ण सांस्कृतिक बातचीत उच्च सीमित अनुभवी ट्रेकर्स के लेल सर्वश्रेष्ठ समय सीमित यात्री |

टेबुल पर अंक मात्र कथाक किछु हिस्सा कहैत अछि, तथापि। जं अहां जे चाहैत छी से चुनौती थिक - लंबा दिनक पैदल यात्रा, पैरक नीचा पहाड़ी दर्रा, दूरस्थ परिदृश्य, आ एहि ऊँच घाटीमें जीवन कोना चलैत छैक, तकर वास्तविक अनुभूति - तं, थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक एहन तरीका सं पहुंचाबैत अछि जे आन किछु नहिं क सकैत अछि. मुदा, जं अहाँक प्राथमिकता बस एवरेस्ट देखब थिक, आ बिना दिनक उच्च ऊँचाई पर पैदल चलने कड़ा कार्यक्रमक भीतर करब तं हेलीकॉप्टर भ्रमण बहुत बेसी सार्थक. दुनू मे सँ कोनो विकल्प “बेसी नीक” नहि। बस अलग-अलग लोकक लेल बनल अछि.

कठिनाई, ऊंचाई एवं भौतिक तैयारी

एकरा चीनी लेप नहिं छैक — थ्री हाई पास मार्ग एवरेस्ट क्षेत्रक कठिन ट्रेकमें सं एक थिक, आ प्रतिबद्धता सं पहिने एकर कारण बुझब उचित. दिन नमहर होइत अछि, किछु आठ-नौ घंटाक चलैत खिंचैत अछि । चढ़ाई आरू उतराई खड़ा होय छै, खास करी क॑ खुद दर्रा के आसपास, आरू ऊंचाई प॑ ठंड पीक सीजन म॑ भी अप्रत्याशित होय सकै छै । एक यात्रा कार्यक्रमक भीतर कोंगमा ला, चो ला, आ रेंजो ला पीठ-पीठ पार करबा सं अहाँक शरीर सं बहुत किछु पूछल जाइत अछि, खास क' पैर आ फेफड़ा सं.

एतय एक्लिमेटेशन वैकल्पिक नहिं — ई ट्रेक केर पूरा तर्क में निर्मित अछि. धीरे-धीरे ऊंचाई बढ़ना, जेकरा म॑ प्रमुख बिंदु प॑ आराम के दिन निर्धारित करलऽ जाय छै, वू छै जे अधिकांश ट्रेकर्स क॑ सुरक्षित आरू काम करै वाला रखै छै । एहि सं आगू, हृदय संबंधी फिटनेस केर सभ्य आधार रेखा बहुत मदद करैत अछि, जेना कि बाहर उड़बा सं पहिने पहाड़ी इलाका पर किछु पैदल यात्राक अभ्यास. नीक बूट जे पहिने सं टूटल अछि, उचित लेयर वाला कपड़ा, हाइड्रेटेड रहब, आ — एहि एकटा कें जतेक छोड़बाक चाही, ओहि सं बेसी छोड़ि देल जाइत छैक — वास्तव में जं ओ ऊँचाईक लक्षणक जिक्र करैत हो तं अहाँक गाइड सुनब, ई सब लोकक अपेक्षा सं बेसी मायने रखैत अछि. जं स्वास्थ्य संबंधी कोनो अंतर्निहित चिंता अछि तं एहि ऊँचाई पर कोनो चीज बुक करबा सं पहिने डॉक्टर सं गप्प करब उचित.

एवरेस्ट ट्रेकिंग आ हेलीकॉप्टर टूरक लेल सबसँ नीक समय

वसंत ऋतु

मार्च स मई तक एकटा कारण स पसंदीदा अछि। दिन गर्म होय जाय छै, रोडोडेंड्रोन घाटी में निचला भाग में फूलै छै, आरू पहाड़ के दृश्यता अच्छा होय के प्रवृत्ति छै. ईहो बेसी व्यस्त खिड़की में सं एक अछि, तें, पगडंडी पर आ चाहक घर में कंपनीक आशा करू.

शरद ऋतु

सितंबर स॑ नवंबर तलक यकीनन साल केरऽ सबस॑ मजबूत ट्रेकिंग काल छै । आमतौर पर आसमान साफ ​​रहैत अछि, तापमान प्रबंधनीय होइत छैक, आ एहि समय में अधिकांश अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ट्रेकर्स देखाइत छथि.

जाड़ आ मानसून

जाड़ में ऊँच दर्रा पर वास्तव में कठिन परिस्थिति अबैत छैक — काटय बला ठंढा, बीच-बीच में बर्फ बंद होयब, आ दिनक इजोत कम. एम्हर मानसून के मौसम में बादल के आवरण, बरखा के निचला पायदान आ बेर-बेर उड़ान में देरी के प्रवृत्ति रहैत अछि. आ ई बात दोहराबय योग्य अछि : हेलीकॉप्टर सं भ्रमण मौसमक अनुकूल नहिं. कम दृश्यता या तेज हवा उड़ान कें ओतबे आसानी सं ग्राउंड क’ सकैत अछि जतेक कि लुकला उड़ान रद्द क’ सकैत अछि, तें हेलीकॉप्टर विकल्प कें कोनो तरहक गारंटीड बैकअप योजना नहिं मानू.

परमिट, उड़ान, आवास आ लागत आमतौर पर की निर्भर करएयत छै

खुम्बूमें पैर रखबा सं पहिने कागजी काज छैक — सागरमाथा नेशनल पार्कमें प्रवेश ले परमिट चाही, आ अहाँक मार्गक आधार पर स्थानीय ट्रेकिंग परमिट सेहो लागू भ’ सकैत अछि. अधिकांश ट्रेकर्स शुरू करय लेल लुकला में उड़ैत छथि, रास्ता में चाय घर में रहैत छथि, जाहि में भोजन आमतौर पर पैकेज के हिस्सा के रूप में शामिल कयल जाइत अछि. इलाका कें देखैत थ्री हाई पास मार्ग पर गाइड आ पोर्टर आवश्यकक करीब अछि, आ उच्च ऊँचाई पर ट्रेकिंग (आ हेलीकॉप्टर सं बाहर निकालब, आदर्श रूपें) कवर करयवला यात्रा बीमा एहन बात थिक जकरा ककरो छोड़बाक नहिं चाही.

एकटा निश्चित दाम जे एक सालक भीतर पुरान भ’ जायत, से बेसी ईमानदारी सं कहब जे लागत काफी किछु चलैत भाग पर निर्भर करैत अछि — जाहि मौसम में यात्रा करब, समूहक आकार, ट्रेक कतेक दिन चलैत अछि, चाहे अहाँ निजी गाइड आ पोर्टर राखि रहल छी वा कोनो समूह में शामिल भ’ रहल छी, चाय घरक आवासक मानक, आ हेलीकॉप्टर विकल्पक हेतु, उपलब्धता आ फ्लाइट साझा क’ रहल छी वा एकरा निजी तौर पर बुकिंग करब। जे कियो अहां के बिना पहिने ई सवाल पूछने सही नंबर उद्धृत क रहल छथिन्ह ओ एक डेग छोड़ि रहल छथिन्ह.

नेपाल मे ट्रेकिंग कम्पनी कैसे चुने |

एहि ठाम बहुत रास यात्रा चुपचाप गड़बड़ भ जाइत छैक, आ एकर पहाड़ सं कोनो संबंध शायदे कखनो होइत छैक.

कानूनी आ पेशेवर क्रेडेंशियल चेक करू

उचित पंजीकरण, अहां जे विशिष्ट मार्ग पर जा रहल छी, ओकर वास्तविक अनुभव वाला गाइड, ओकर अंत पर सही ट्रेकिंग अनुमति छाँटल, कंपनीक स्पष्ट आ पहुँच योग्य जानकारी, आ जखन पूछब जे आपातकाल में की होइत छैक तं वास्तविक जवाब देखू. जँ कोनो कंपनी ओहि अंतिम बात पर अस्पष्ट भ’ जाइत अछि त’ ओ गंभीरता स’ लेब’ लायक लाल झंडा अछि.

सस्ता पैकेज स परे देखू

पेज पर सबसँ कम दाम शायदे पूरा कहानी कहैत अछि। वास्तव मे की सब शामिल अछि? की नहि? की गाइड सब ठीक सं प्रशिक्षित छथि, पोर्टर लोकनिक संग निष्पक्ष व्यवहार आ ठंढाक लेल सुसज्जित छथि, आवास जे वादा कयल गेल छल, आ की कंपनी यात्रा सं पहिने आ यात्राक दौरान स्पष्ट संवाद करैत अछि — केवल तखन नहिं जखन अहाँ पाइ द’ रहल छी, बल्कि जखन मौसम वा स्वास्थ्यक संग किछु कात भ’ जाइत अछि. ई सब सवाल नेपाल के नीक ट्रेकिंग एजेंसी के ओहि एजेंसी सं अलग करैत अछि जे सिर्फ मार्केटिंग में नीक अछि.

समीक्षा ध्यान स पढ़ू

एकटा चमकैत पांच सितारा समीक्षाक मतलब अपने आप मे बहुत कम अछि। एकरऽ बदला म॑ बहुत समीक्षा म॑ पैटर्न देखऽ — गाइड प्रोफेशनलिज्म प॑ टिप्पणी, कंपनी न॑ कोना संवाद करलकै, सुरक्षा केरऽ स्थिति क॑ कोना संभाललकै, की कीमत निर्धारण वू वादा स॑ मेल खाबै छै कि नै, आरू जब॑ उड़ान म॑ देरी होय गेलै या आखिरी समय म॑ योजना म॑ बदलाव होय गेलै त॑ ओकरऽ प्रतिक्रिया केना छेलै । असली यात्रीक अनुभव, खास क' गन्दा अनुभव, पॉलिश प्रशंसापत्र सं बेसी किछु कहैत अछि. ई वास्तव में नेपालक सब सं नीक ट्रेकिंग कंपनी खोजबाक मूल थिक — पॉलिश सं बेसी पैटर्न, आ सब सं सस्ता बोली सं लाइसेंस प्राप्त ट्रेकिंग गाइड.

एवरेस्ट ट्रेकिंग ऑपरेटर के विश्वसनीय की बनाबै छै?

एकटा वास्तविक सक्षम ऑपरेटर अहाँ केँ खाली पैकेज नहि बेचत — ओ सब एकरा बुझा देत. यात्रा कार्यक्रम आ एहिमें अनुकूलन कोना बनल अछि, ऊँचाईक जोखिम, परमिटक आवश्यकता, मौसम योजनाकें बाधित करबामें की होइत छैक, आपातकालीन प्रक्रिया, बीमाक अपेक्षा, उपकरण जकरा आनय पड़त बनाम ओ जे उपलब्ध कराबैत अछि, योग्यताक मार्गदर्शन, योग्यताक मार्गदर्शन, आ — जं प्रासंगिक हो तं — हेलीकॉप्टर सं निकासी वा आकस्मिक व्यवस्थाक विषयमें पूछू. जेकरा “सर्वश्रेष्ठ” होय के दावा करै छै ओकरा पीछा करै के बजाय ई जानना बेसी उपयोगी छै कि जबे वू आपनो सवालऽ के जवाब दै छै त॑ वास्तव म॑ सक्षम ऑपरेटर केना लगै छै । जे कोनो स्टार रेटिंग स’ बहुत नीक फिल्टर अछि.

या त एवरेस्ट अनुभव के लेल की पैक करब

थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक ले असली ठंढा आ असली दूरी ले पैक करू : ठोस ट्रेकिंग बूट, गर्म परत, नीक डाउन जैकेट, दस्ताना, धूप-चश्मा, धूप सं सुरक्षा, पुन: उपयोग योग्य पानिक बोतल, हेडलैंप, सब-जीरो राति ले रेटेड स्लीपिंग बैग, कोनो व्यक्तिगत दवाई, आ बुनियादी प्राथमिक चिकित्सा आपूर्ति.

हेलीकॉप्टर भ्रमणक हेतु ई सूची काफी सिकुड़ि जाइत अछि — छोट स्टॉपक दौरान सेहो ऊँचाई पर ठंढाक हेतु गर्म कपड़ा, धूप-चश्मा, अहाँक कैमरा वा फोन चार्ज आ तैयार, पहचान आ यात्राक दस्तावेज, आ यात्रा बीमा. कारण, एकटा यात्रा हफ्ता-हफ्ता आ दोसर घंटों चलैत अछि, तें ई तर्कसंगत अछि जे जे किछु ल' क' चलैत छी से लगभग किछुओ एक समान नहिं.

जखन प्रत्येक विकल्प बेसी सार्थक होयत

जं समय भेटि गेल हो तं, वास्तव में शारीरिक चुनौतीक आनंद लेब, असली हिमालयी दर्रा पार करय चाहैत छी, आ खुम्बूक परिदृश्य आ ओकर गाम सब सं गहींर बातचीतक पछाति छी — जतय यात्रा स्वयं यात्राक बिंदु बनि जाइत अछि.

जं समय सीमित हो, बिना हफ्ताक पैदल यात्राक पहाड़क दृश्य चाही, भौतिक मांग कम हो, आ एहि बात सं सहज हो जे मौसम अहाँक कार्यक्रम कनेक इधर-उधर बदलि सकैत अछि तं एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप हेलीकॉप्टर टूर सं जाउ.

अनुभवी स्थानीय संचालक कें चयन पर एकटा टिप्पणी

क्षेत्र केरऽ स्थापित ऑपरेटरऽ के तुलना करतें समय ई देखै म॑ मदद मिलै छै कि गाइड अनुभव, यात्रा कार्यक्रम कतेक पारदर्शी छै, सुरक्षा केरऽ योजना केतना छै, आरू वू वास्तव म॑ जमीन प॑ एवरेस्ट क्षेत्र क॑ कतेक अच्छा स॑ जान॑ छै । एडवेंचर ग्रेट हिमालय सन कंपनी एहि गप्प-सप्प में ठीक एहिलेल अबैत अछि जे यात्री लोकनि ऑपरेटर कें ठीक एहि मानदंडक विरुद्ध तौलबाक प्रवृत्ति रखैत छथि — चमकदार मार्केटिंगक विरुद्ध नहिं, बल्कि वास्तविक, चेक करय योग्य अनुभवक विरुद्ध.

अंतिम विचार — एवरेस्ट अनुभव चुनू जे अहाँक फिट हो

दिनक अंतमें एवरेस्ट थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक चुनौती, विसर्जन, आ एकटा एहन परिदृश्यमें घुमबामें बिताओल दिनक विषय थिक जे अहाँक बूटक नीचा बदलैत रहैत अछि. एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप हेलीकॉप्टर टूर गति, सुविधा, आ घर सं बिना हफ्ताक दूरी पर हिमालयक ओ अविस्मरणीय हवाई दृश्य प्राप्त करबाक विषय थिक. दुनू मे सँ कोनो “सही” विकल्प नहि अछि — ई सभ त’ अलग-अलग प्रश्नक उत्तर मात्र अछि ।

जे रास्ता पर जाउ, नेपालक जे ट्रेकिंग कंपनी चुनब ओकर गुणवत्ता लोकक अपेक्षा सं बेसी पूरा अनुभव कें आकार देत. बुकिंग सं पहिने यात्रा कार्यक्रम, समावेश, सुरक्षा व्यवस्था, गाइड अनुभव, मौसम नीति, आ कुल लागतक कात-कात तुलना करू. नीक ऑपरेटर के एहि सभ के साफ-साफ घुमाबय लेल तैयार रहबाक चाही, नहि कि सिर्फ बिक्री के तरफ धकेलय के.

बार-बार पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न

की एवरेस्ट थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप ट्रेक सं कठिन अछि ?

हँ, ध्यान देबय योग्य अछि। तीन पास केरऽ मार्ग स॑ कोंगमा ला, चो ला, आरू रेंजो ला क॑ मिश्रण म॑ जोड़लऽ जाय छै, जेकरऽ मतलब छै कि मानक एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप ट्रेक के तुलना म॑ ऊंचाई म॑ अधिक बढ़ोत्तरी, कठिन इलाका, आरू दिन भी लम्बा ।

की एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप हेलीकॉप्टर टूर एकर लायक अछि ?

सीमित समय या कम शारीरिक क्षमता वाला यात्री लेली ई प्रायः होय छै — ट्रेकिंग केरऽ भौतिक टोल के बिना एवरेस्ट आरू आसपास केरऽ चोटी सब क॑ नजदीक स॑ देखै के मौका मिलै छै । बस ध्यान राखब जे ई मौसम पर बेसी निर्भर अछि, तें अपन कार्यक्रमक आसपास लचीलापन मदद करैत अछि.

कोन नीक, एवरेस्ट थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक वा हेलीकॉप्टर टूर ?

ई सचमुच एहि बात पर निर्भर करैत अछि जे के पूछि रहल अछि. पहाड़ में विसर्जन, चुनौती, आ समय चाहैत ट्रेकर्स तीन पास वाला मार्ग पसंद करताह. समय कम करय वाला या एवरेस्ट देखय के कम प्रभाव वाला तरीका खोजय वाला यात्री के संभवतः हेलीकॉप्टर दौरा सं बेसी फायदा मिलत.

नेपाल मे ट्रेकिंग कंपनी कोना चुनब?

ओकर पंजीकरण आ परमिट कें जांच करूं, गाइड कें अनुभव आ योग्यता कें देखूं, सुरक्षा प्रक्रिया आ आपातकालीन सहायता कें बारे मे पूछूं, सुनिश्चित करूं कि मूल्य निर्धारण पारदर्शी छै, आ केवल शीर्ष किछु कें बजाय समीक्षा कें एकटा श्रृंखला पढ़ूं.

एवरेस्ट थ्री हाई पास ट्रेक आ हेलीकॉप्टर टूरक लेल सब सं नीक समय की अछि ?

full_article:
Anil Kumar Sah will captain Nepal in the Top End T20 series.

Kathmandu, August 18

Nepal are set to make their second consecutive appearance in Australia’s Top End T20 Series, with the Nepal A team heading to Darwin for the tournament beginning August 21.

Unlike last year, when Nepal sent its senior national team, the Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) has selected a 15-member Nepal A squad for this year’s tournament. Anil Kumar Sah will captain the side.

The senior team’s commitments in the ACC Premier Cup have prompted CAN to send the A team to Australia.

The tournament will provide Nepal’s emerging players with exposure to Australian conditions and competitive opposition. Nepal will play six league matches against NT Strike, Bangladesh High Performance, Hobart Hurricanes Academy, ACT Comets, Kingsmen and Victoria CA XI.

Nepal will open its campaign against NT Strike on August 21 before facing Bangladesh High Performance on August 22. The team will then play Hobart Hurricanes Academy on August 24, ACT Comets on August 26, Kingsmen on August 27 and Victoria CA XI on August 29.

Building on last year’s experience

Nepal made its Top End T20 debut last year with the senior national team. It won two of its six league matches and lost four.

Nepal defeated Hobart Hurricanes Academy and Melbourne Renegades Academy but lost to Melbourne Stars Academy, NT Strike, Bangladesh A and Pakistan Shaheens.

Five players from last year’s squad—Kushal Bhurtel, Kushal Malla, Lokesh Bam, Rupesh Singh and Shah Alam—are returning for the tournament this year.

Bhurtel’s inclusion gives the A team an added boost. The regular national team member has been rested from ODI cricket for a period and has been included in the squad for the T20 tournament.

Captain Sah said the tournament would be a major opportunity for the players.

“Our preparations have been good. We have also spoken to senior players about the conditions there and learned how to prepare mentally,” Sah said. “Playing this tournament as Nepal A is a big opportunity and will provide valuable exposure.”

A test ahead of the Asian Games

The Top End T20 Series will also serve as an important preparation platform for players hoping to make Nepal’s squad for the Asian Games in Japan, which begin on September 24.

Several players involved in the tournament are part of Nepal’s preliminary Asian Games plans, although the final squad could change after the Australia tour.

Nepal can play at least six matches in the Top End T20. If it reaches the semi-finals and final, the team could play up to eight matches.

Nepal’s 15-member squad

ऑस्ट्रेलिया केरऽ टॉप एंड टी-२० सीरीज म॑ नेपाल लगातार दोसरऽ बार खेलै वाला छै, जेकरा म॑ नेपाल ए टीम २१ अगस्त स॑ शुरू होय वाला ई टूर्नामेंट लेली डार्विन जाय रहलऽ छै ।

पिछला साल जखन नेपाल अपन वरिष्ठ राष्ट्रीय टीम पठेलक तखन क्रिकेट संघ नेपाल (सीएएन) एहि बेरक टूर्नामेंट लेल 15 सदस्यीय नेपाल ए टीमक चयन केलक अछि। अनिल कुमार साह टीमक कप्तान बनताह।

एसीसी प्रीमियर कप म॑ सीनियर टीम केरऽ प्रतिबद्धता के वजह स॑ कैन न॑ ए टीम क॑ ऑस्ट्रेलिया भेजलकै ।

ई टूर्नामेंट स॑ नेपाल केरऽ उभरतऽ खिलाड़ी क॑ ऑस्ट्रेलिया केरऽ परिस्थिति आरू प्रतिस्पर्धी विरोध के संपर्क म॑ आबै के मौका मिलतै । नेपाल एनटी स्ट्राइक, बांग्लादेश हाई परफॉर्मेंस, होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी, एसीटी कॉमेट्स, किंग्समेन आ विक्टोरिया सीए इलेवन के खिलाफ छह लीग मैच खेलत।

नेपाल 21 अगस्त कए एनटी स्ट्राइक क खिलाफ अभियान शुरू करत आ 22 अगस्त कए बांग्लादेश हाई परफॉर्मेंस क सामना करत।तखन टीम 24 अगस्त कए होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी, 26 अगस्त कए एक्ट कॉमेट्स, 27 अगस्त कए किंग्समेन आ 29 अगस्त कए विक्टोरिया सीए इलेवन स मुकाबला करत।

पिछला साल’क अनुभव पर आधारित

नेपाल पिछला साल सीनियर राष्ट्रीय टीम के संग टॉप एंड टी-20 के शुरुआत केने छल। अपनऽ छह लीग मैचऽ म॑ स॑ दू मैच जीती क॑ ४ मैच हारलऽ छेलै ।

नेपाल होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी आ मेलबर्न रेनेगेड्स एकेडमी के पराजित केलक मुदा मेलबर्न स्टार एकेडमी, एनटी स्ट्राइक, बांग्लादेश ए आ पाकिस्तान शाहीनस स हारल छल ।

पिछला साल के टीम के पांच खिलाड़ी कुशल भूर्टेल, कुशल मल्ला, लोकेश बम, रूपेश सिंह आओर शाह आलम एहि साल एहि टूर्नामेंट के लेल वापसी क रहल छथिन्ह.

भूर्टेल केरऽ शामिल होय स॑ ए टीम क॑ एगो आरू बढ़ावा मिलै छै । नियमित राष्ट्रीय टीम के सदस्य क॑ एक अवधि लेली वनडे क्रिकेट स॑ आराम देलऽ गेलऽ छै आरू टी-२० टूर्नामेंट लेली टीम म॑ शामिल करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

कप्तान साह नँ कहलकै कि ई टूर्नामेंट खिलाड़ी सिनी लेली एगो बड़ौ अवसर होतै ।

साह कहलनि जे, हमर सबहक तैयारी नीक रहल अछि, हम सब सीनियर खिलाड़ी सब स सेहो ओतय के हालत के बारे में बात केलहुं आ मानसिक रूप स तैयारी के तरीका सीखलहुं। “नेपाल ए के रूप में ई टूर्नामेंट खेलना एकटा पैघ अवसर अछि आ मूल्यवान एक्सपोजर भेटत।”

एशियाई खेल स आगू एकटा परीक्षा

टॉप एंड टी-20 सीरीज जापान म॑ होबै वाला एशियाई खेलऽ लेली नेपाल केरऽ टीम बनाबै के उम्मीद करै वाला खिलाड़ी लेली भी एगो महत्वपूर्ण तैयारी मंच के रूप म॑ काम करतै, जे 24 सितंबर स॑ शुरू होय रहलऽ छै ।

ई टूर्नामेंट स॑ जुड़लऽ कईएक खिलाड़ी नेपाल केरऽ एशियाई खेलऽ के प्रारंभिक योजना के हिस्सा छै, हालांकि ऑस्ट्रेलिया दौरा के बाद अंतिम टीम म॑ बदलाव आबी सकै छै ।

टॉप एंड टी-20 मे नेपाल कम स कम छह मैच खेल सकैत अछि। अगर ई सेमीफाइनल आरू फाइनल म॑ पहुँची जाय छै त॑ टीम आठ मैच तलक खेली सकै छै ।

full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 18: The Last rites of Nepali and Nepal Bhasa senior poet Durgalal Shrestha were performed with national honour.

Shrestha, who passed away at his Budhanilkantha-based residence on Sunday night at the age of 93, was cremated at Shovabhagawati on Tuesday evening.

On the occasion, Home Minister Sudhan Gurung, Minister for Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation, Biraj Bhakta Shrestha, Acting Mayor of Kathmandu Metropolitan City, Sunita Dangol, as well as other senior personalities paid last tributes to late Shrestha.

Earlier, a procession carrying the mortal remains of Shrestha had started from Shova Bhagawati and concluded after reaching the same place going through Chhetrapati, Thahiti, Bangemuda, Asan, Janabahal, Kilagal and Nardevi.

Senior personalities of different sectors, litterateurs, artists, musicians, well-wishers and general people also paid tributes to late Shrestha.

With the demise of Shrestha, Nepali literature has lost a powerful literary figure, who built a literary bridge between Nepal Bhasa and Nepali language. He spent more than seven decades in the promotion of poem, song, child literature, drama and Nepal Bhasa for around seven decades.

Madan Puraskar Guthi had honoured Shrestha with the 'Jagadamba-Shree' award for his contribution on literature sector.

Born in 1992 BS in Kathmandu, Shrestha's first poem 'Dui Thopa' was published in 2009. The famous songs --'Saya Thari Baja Eutai Taal', 'Phoolko Aankhanma Phoolai Sansara' are Shrestha's creations. (RSS)

title: India-Nepal defence ties in focus as Army chief meets PM Balendra Shah - India Today
description: India-Nepal defence ties in focus as Army chief meets PM Balendra Shah  India Today

full_article:
Indian Army chief General Dhiraj Seth on Tuesday met Nepal Prime Minister and Defence Minister Balendra Shah and held what the Indian Embassy described as a "warm and productive discussion" on strengthening defence cooperation between the two countries. Indian Ambassador to Nepal Naveen Srivastava was also present at the meeting at the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers.

advertisement ❮❯

Read Full Story

The meeting took place during a period of unease in ties between India and Nepal. According to sources at the Prime Minister's secretariat, the two sides discussed matters of bilateral interest and ways to strengthen military relations between the neighbours.

Earlier this month, Shah held his first one-on-one meeting with Ambassador Srivastava and stressed the need to deepen Nepal's "historic relationship" with India. In recent weeks, Shah has moved away from his self-imposed rule of avoiding one-on-one engagements with foreign ambassadors and senior visiting officials.

General Seth is on a four-day official visit to Nepal from August 17 to 19 at the invitation of his Nepali counterpart, General Ashok Raj Sigdel. On Monday, President Ramchandra Paudel conferred on him the rank of Honorary General of the Nepali Army at a ceremony in Kathmandu. Nepal and India have followed a longstanding tradition since 1950 of conferring the honorary rank of General on each other's army chiefs, in what has been described as a unique and time-honoured military practice.

General Seth also held bilateral talks with General Sigdel at the Army Headquarters on Monday, where they discussed matters of mutual interest. The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu said the visit "reaffirms the unique and time-tested defence relations between India and Nepal, which are rooted in shared values, mutual trust, and enduring military-to-military ties".

The visit comes against the backdrop of wider political developments in Nepal's engagement with its neighbours. Nepal's leaders have traditionally attached importance to early engagement with New Delhi because of the close political, economic and people-to-people ties between the two countries. Shah, however, has not visited either India or China since taking office. Instead, Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal made back-to-back visits to New Delhi and Beijing in June. Shah's predecessor K P Sharma Oli had visited China after taking over in 2024, departing from the earlier practice of Nepal's prime ministers making India their first foreign visit.

In his first appearance in Parliament on May 31, Shah had said he had learnt about his country "encroaching" territories in India. He also said that apart from discussions with India on the long-running border dispute, Kathmandu was in touch with China and the UK as well. Two days later, New Delhi rejected any role for third parties in resolving its boundary dispute with Nepal. The two countries have an old dispute over Lipulekh, Limpiyadhura and Kalapani, which India has consistently maintained are part of Uttarakhand. Soon after Shah's remarks, Nepal's ruling Rastriya Swatantra Party chairman Rabi Lamichhane visited India and met top Indian leaders.

He also offered prayers at the Pashupatinath Temple in Kathmandu on Tuesday, Nepal Army sources said. Overall, the visit combined ceremonial, military and diplomatic engagements as both sides discussed defence ties and broader bilateral issues.

विज्ञापन ❮❯ २.

पूरा कहानी पढ़ें

भारत आ नेपालक बीच सम्बन्धमे असहजताक समयमे ई बैसार भेल अछि । प्रधानमंत्री सचिवालय के सूत्र के अनुसार दुनु पक्ष द्विपक्षीय हित के मामला आ पड़ोसी देश के बीच सैन्य संबंध मजबूत करय के तरीका पर चर्चा केलक।

एहि मासक शुरुआत मे शाह राजदूत श्रीवास्तव क संग पहिल एक-एक बैसार केलथि आ भारत स नेपाल क ‘ऐतिहासिक संबंध’ कए गहरा करबाक जरूरत पर जोर देलथि। हाल के हफ्ता म॑ शाह न॑ विदेशी राजदूत आरू वरिष्ठ विजिटिंग अधिकारियऽ स॑ एक-एक करी क॑ बातचीत स॑ बचै के अपनऽ स्वंय थोपलऽ नियम स॑ दूर होय गेलऽ छै ।

जनरल सेठ अपन नेपाली समकक्ष जनरल अशोक राज सिग्देल के आमंत्रण पर 17 सँ 19 अगस्त धरि नेपाल के चारि दिवसीय आधिकारिक यात्रा पर छथि । सोमदिन राष्ट्रपति रामचन्द्र पौडेल काठमांडू मे आयोजित एकटा समारोह मे हुनका नेपाली सेना के मानद जनरल के पदवी प्रदान केलनि। नेपाल आरू भारत १९५० स॑ ही एक-दूसरा के सेना प्रमुख क॑ जनरल के मानद पद प्रदान करै के एगो लंबा परंपरा के पालन करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा एगो अद्वितीय आरू समय स॑ सम्मानित सैन्य प्रथा के रूप म॑ वर्णित करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

title: Bangladeshi scientist receives UK exploration award for Nepal Indigenous knowledge project - The Daily Star
description: Bangladeshi scientist receives UK exploration award for Nepal Indigenous knowledge project  The Daily Star
publisher.title: The Daily Star
full_article:
Abdullah Rubaet Chowdhury, a Bangladeshi social scientist and anthropologist, has received the SES Elodie Sandford Award from the UK-based Scientific Exploration Society (SES) for a planned research expedition documenting Indigenous ecological knowledge in Nepal’s Himalayan Mustang region.

The award will support a year-long expedition focused on Nepal's Bönpo community, which is home to one of the world’s oldest continuous knowledge traditions dating back 18,000 years, and its approaches to the natural environment.

Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source

Rubaet Chowdhury said the research would examine how Bönpo practitioners respond to environmental and climatic changes through knowledge rooted in their relationship with nature.

“Our expedition is particularly interested in learning how Bönpo practitioners, placed at the forefront of the climate crisis, have maintained a strong kinship with nature and natural entities driven by their ‘living knowledge’ to face these challenges,” he said.

The expedition is expected to take place in the Mustang region around the Kali Gandaki Gorge, an environmentally and culturally distinctive area of the trans-Himalayan landscape.

According to the expedition team, the project will use a collaborative research model intended to avoid treating Indigenous knowledge simply as information to be extracted by outside researchers.

Rubaet Chowdhury and his team plan to work with Bön spiritual leaders and young people using an ethnophotography-based approach. The researchers say they will jointly develop biodiversity conservation indicators, participatory maps and a community-owned field film.

The project aims to connect local environmental practices with contemporary biodiversity policy while allowing the community to retain ownership of the knowledge and materials produced during the research.

Findings from the expedition are expected to be shared with bodies involved in implementing the UN Global Biodiversity Framework, including the secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity, as well as Nepal’s Ministry of Forests and Environment, according to the press release.

The team also plans exhibitions and academic presentations, including at Heidelberg University’s ethnographic museum and institutions in Nepal.

The Scientific Exploration Society is a UK organisation that supports expeditions combining scientific research, exploration and conservation.

बांग्लादेशी सामाजिक वैज्ञानिक आरू मानवशास्त्री अब्दुल्ला रुबेत चौधरी क॑ नेपाल केरऽ हिमालयन मस्टैंग क्षेत्र म॑ स्वदेशी पारिस्थितिकी ज्ञान के दस्तावेजीकरण करै वाला योजनाबद्ध शोध अभियान लेली यूके स्थित वैज्ञानिक अन्वेषण सोसाइटी (एसईएस) स॑ एसईएस एलोडी सैंडफोर्ड पुरस्कार मिललऽ छै ।

ई पुरस्कार नेपाल केरऽ बोनपो समुदाय, जे १८,००० साल पुरानऽ दुनिया केरऽ सबसें पुरानऽ निरंतर ज्ञान परंपरा म॑ स॑ एक के घर छै, आरू प्राकृतिक पर्यावरण के प्रति एकरऽ दृष्टिकोण प॑ केंद्रित साल भर के अभियान क॑ समर्थन देतै ।

द डेली स्टार के विश्वसनीय स्रोत के रूप में जोड़य लेल एतय टैप करू

रुबाएत चौधरी नँ कहलकै कि ई शोध मँ ई जांच करलौ जैतै कि बोनपो के व्यवसायी प्रकृति के साथ अपनौ संबंध मँ जड़ जमाय वाला ज्ञान के माध्यम स॑ पर्यावरण आरू जलवायु परिवर्तन के प्रति कोन तरह के प्रतिक्रिया दै छै ।

हुनी कहलकै, “हमरऽ अभियान ई जानय मँ विशेष रूप स॑ दिलचस्पी रखै छै कि जलवायु संकट म॑ सबसें आगू रखलऽ गेलऽ बोनपो केरऽ व्यवसायी न॑ ई चुनौती के सामना करै लेली अपनऽ ‘जीवित ज्ञान’ स॑ संचालित प्रकृति आरू प्राकृतिक इकाइयऽ के साथ मजबूत रिश्तेदारी क॑ कोना कायम रखन॑ छै ।

ई अभियान हिमालय पार केरऽ परिदृश्य केरऽ पर्यावरण आरू सांस्कृतिक रूप स॑ विशिष्ट क्षेत्र काली गंडकी गॉर्ज के आसपास के मस्टैंग क्षेत्र म॑ होय के उम्मीद छै ।

अभियान टीम के अनुसार ई परियोजना म॑ सहयोगात्मक शोध मॉडल के उपयोग करलऽ जैतै जेकरऽ उद्देश्य स्वदेशी ज्ञान क॑ खाली बाहरी शोधकर्ता सिनी द्वारा निकालै वाला जानकारी के रूप म॑ नै मानलऽ जाय ।

रुबेत चौधरी आरू हुनकऽ टीम न॑ नृवंशविज्ञान आधारित दृष्टिकोण के उपयोग करी क॑ बोन आध्यात्मिक नेता आरू युवा सिनी के साथ काम करै के योजना बना रहलऽ छै । शोधकर्ता सब के कहना छै कि हुनी संयुक्त रूप स॑ जैव विविधता संरक्षण सूचक, भागीदारी वाला नक्शा आरू समुदाय के स्वामित्व वाला फील्ड फिल्म तैयार करतै ।

परियोजना कें उद्देश्य स्थानीय पर्यावरण प्रथाक कें समकालीन जैव विविधता नीति सं जोड़नाय छै आ संगहि समुदाय कें शोध कें दौरान उत्पादित ज्ञान आ सामग्री कें स्वामित्व बरकरार रखनाय छै.

प्रेस विज्ञप्ति मे कहल गेल अछि जे एहि अभियान सँ प्राप्त निष्कर्ष संयुक्त राष्ट्र वैश्विक जैव विविधता ढाँचा लागू करबा मे लागल निकाय मे साझा करबाक उम्मीद अछि, जाहि मे जैविक विविधता महासन्धिक सचिवालयक संग-संग नेपालक वन आ पर्यावरण मंत्रालय सेहो शामिल अछि ।

टीम न॑ प्रदर्शनी आरू शैक्षणिक प्रस्तुति के योजना भी बनाबै छै, जेकरा म॑ हाइडलबर्ग विश्वविद्यालय केरऽ नृवंशविज्ञान संग्रहालय आरू नेपाल केरऽ संस्थानऽ म॑ भी शामिल छै ।

वैज्ञानिक अन्वेषण सोसाइटी यूके केरऽ एगो संगठन छेकै जे वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधान, अन्वेषण आरू संरक्षण के संयोजन वाला अभियानऽ के समर्थन करै छै ।

Kathmandu, Aug 18: In a meeting of the House of Representatives (HoR) today, the lower house members drew the government's attention to various contemporary issues including the short-supplies of cooking gas, and chemical fertilizer, and the need for monsoon-related disasters and menace from wildlife.

Airing views during a zero hour, Buddha Ratna Maharjan demanded the government ensure healthcare facilities, roadway access, seeds and chemical fertilizers to the citizens promptly.

Basana Thapa was of the view that increasing price hike has posed challenges to citizens to manage two square meals.

Balawati Sharma demanded an end to situations forcing Nepali foreign migrants falling prey to fraud and life-threatening situations.

Bina Gurung, Buddhi Prasad Pant, Basumaya Tamang, Bharat Kumar Swar, Bharat Prasad Parajuli, Bharat Bahadur Khadka, Bheem Kumar Budha Magar, Madan Krishna Shrestha, Madhav Bahadur Thapa, Manamaya Bishwakarma, Manish Khanal, Mohanlal Acharya, Yagya Bahadur Bogati, and Ranju Neupane were among those lawmakers drawing the government's attention to contemporary issues.

Likewise, Rachana Khatiwada, Rabin Mahato, Rajani Shrestha, Ratna Kumari Thapa, Ramesh Kumar Malla, Ramesh Kumar Sapkota, Ramesh Prasai, Rabindra Patel, Raj Kishor Mahato, Mahato, Rajan Gautam, Rajiv Khatri, Rajesh Kumar Chaudhary, Radhika Ramtel, Dr Ram Lama, Ringala Yadav, Reena Upreti, Rukesh Ranjit, Rukmini Devi Koirala, Rekha Kumari Yadav and Renuka Kaucha also spoke during the zero hour session.

The opposition lawmakers put an end to their protest from today, demanding the Prime Minister's respond in the House after Speaker Dol Prasad Aryal on Monday issued ruling directing the Prime Minister for replying the lawmakers' concerns.(RSS)

तहिना रचना खतिवाड़ा, रबिन महतो, रजनी श्रेष्ठ, रत्न कुमारी थापा, रमेश कुमार मल्ल, रमेश कुमार सापकोटा, रमेश प्रसाई, रवीन्द्र पटेल, राज किशोर महतो, महतो, राजन गौतम, राजीव खत्री, राजेश कुमार चौधरी, राधिका रामटेल, डॉ राम लामा, रिंगाला यादव, रीना जीरो आवर सत्र मे उप्रेती, रुकेश रंजीत, रुक्मिणी देवी कोइराला, रेखा कुमारी यादव आ रेणुका कौचा सेहो अपन बात रखलनि।

KUCHING, Malaysia, 19 August 2026: PATA Nepal Chapter has been selected as the winner of the PATA Award of Excellence, presented by the Pacific Asia Travel Association during the PATA Chapter and Student Chapter Awards Ceremony held on Monday, 17 August 2026, at Commons Café, Old Court House, Kuching — a day before the PATA Travel Mart 2026 opened in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia.

The PATA Award of Excellence is presented annually to PATA Chapters and Student Chapters whose activities over the preceding year best exemplify dedication to developing the travel and tourism industry within the Pacific Asia region, in a manner consistent with PATA’s aims and objectives.

PATA Nepal Chapter Immediate Past Chairman, Bibhuti Chand Thakur, received the award on behalf of the association from Sarawak Tourism Board CEO Dr Sharzede Datu Haji Salleh Askor (left) and PATA CEO Noor Ahmad Hamid (right).

PATA Nepal Chapter Immediate Past Chairman Bibhuti Chand Thakur received the award on behalf of the association. Extending his appreciation to PATA HQ for the recognition, he affirmed the dedicated role of PATA Nepal Chapter’s Executive Committee and Secretariat team, led by its CEO, “without whom the Chapter’s significant milestones and achievements over the years would not have been possible”.

PATA Nepal Chapter CEO Suresh Singh Budal said it was a proud moment for both PATA Nepal Chapter and Nepal to be recognised once again with the prestigious PATA Award of Excellence.

He noted that PATA Nepal Chapter has consistently demonstrated excellence in its advocacy and engagement roles over the years, positioning itself as one of the most active PATA Chapters worldwide.

The chapter travelled to Kuching with 17 delegates from 10 companies to participate in business networking at the Nepal Pavilion and showcase Destination Nepal on the international stage from 18 to 20 August.

About PATA Nepal Chapter

Pacific Asia Travel Association (PATA) Nepal Chapter is one of the independent PATA Chapters worldwide, established in 1975 in line with the spirit of PATA HQ. It has since become the only full-fledged tourism association in Nepal, encompassing almost all stakeholders of Nepali tourism from both the public and private sectors, with advocacy and engagement roles for the sustainable development of the travel and tourism industry in Nepal and beyond.

कुचिंग, मलेशिया, १९ अगस्त २०२६ : पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर क॑ कुचिंग, २०२६ म॑ सोमवार, १७ अगस्त २०२६ क॑ कॉमन्स कैफे, ओल्ड कोर्ट हाउस, ओल्ड कोर्ट हाउस म॑ आयोजित पाटा चैप्टर आरू स्टूडेंट चैप्टर पुरस्कार समारोह के दौरान प्रशांत एशिया ट्रैवल एसोसिएशन द्वारा देलऽ गेलऽ पाटा पुरस्कार आफ एक्सीलेंस के विजेता के रूप म॑ चुनलऽ गेलऽ छै — पाटा ट्रैवल मार्ट २०२६ क॑ कुचिंग, २०२६ म॑ खुलला स॑ एक दिन पहलें । सारावाक, मलेशिया।

पाटा उत्कृष्टता पुरस्कार हर साल पाटा चैप्टर आरू छात्र चैप्टर क॑ देलऽ जाय छै, जेकरऽ पिछला साल केरऽ गतिविधि प्रशांत एशिया क्षेत्र के भीतर यात्रा आरू पर्यटन उद्योग क॑ विकसित करै लेली समर्पण केरऽ सबसे अच्छा उदाहरण दै छै, जे पाटा केरऽ उद्देश्य आरू उद्देश्य के अनुरूप तरीका स॑ छै ।

पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर केरऽ तत्काल अतीत केरऽ अध्यक्ष बिभूति चंद ठाकुर न॑ एसोसिएशन के तरफ स॑ ई पुरस्कार सारावाक पर्यटन बोर्ड केरऽ सीईओ डॉ. शारसेदे दातु हाजी सल्लेह अस्कोर (बाँया) आरू पाटा केरऽ सीईओ नूर अहमद हामिद (दाहिना) स॑ सम्मानित करलकै ।

पाटा नेपाल अध्याय के तत्काल अतीत के अध्यक्ष बिभूति चंद ठाकुर संघ के तरफ सँ पुरस्कार प्राप्त केलनि । मान्यता के लेलऽ पाटा मुख्यालय क॑ प्रशंसा करतें हुअ॑ हुनी पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर केरऽ कार्यकारी समिति आरू सचिवालय टीम केरऽ समर्पित भूमिका के पुष्टि करलकै, जेकरऽ नेतृत्व ओकरऽ सीईओ करी रहलऽ छेलै, “जिनकऽ बिना चैप्टर केरऽ सालऽ भर के महत्वपूर्ण मील के पत्थर आरू उपलब्धि संभव नै होतै” ।

पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर के सीईओ सुरेश सिंह बुडाल कहलनि जे, पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर आ नेपाल दुनू के लेल एक बेर फेर सं पाटा के प्रतिष्ठित उत्कृष्टता पुरस्कार सं मान्यता भेटब गौरवशाली क्षण अछि।

हुनी नोट करलकै कि पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर न॑ अपनऽ वकालत आरू संलग्नता के भूमिका म॑ लगातार उत्कृष्टता के प्रदर्शन करलकै, जेकरा स॑ खुद क॑ दुनिया भर म॑ सबसें सक्रिय पाटा चैप्टर म॑ स॑ एक के रूप म॑ स्थापित करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

चैप्टर नेपाल मंडप मे बिजनेस नेटवर्किंग मे भाग लेबाक लेल आ 18 सँ 20 अगस्त धरि अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंच पर डेस्टिनेशन नेपाल के प्रदर्शन करय लेल 10 कंपनी के 17 प्रतिनिधि के संग कुचिंग गेल छल।

पाटा नेपाल अध्याय के बारे में

प्रशांत एशिया यात्रा संघ (पाटा) नेपाल चैप्टर विश्वव्यापी स्वतन्त्र पाटा चैप्टर मे सँ एक अछि, जेकर स्थापना १९७५ मे पाटा मुख्यालयक भावनाक अनुरूप भेल छल । तकर बाद ई नेपालक एकमात्र पूर्ण पर्यटन संघ बनि गेल अछि, जाहि मे सार्वजनिक आ निजी दुनू क्षेत्रक नेपाली पर्यटनक लगभग सभ हितधारक शामिल अछि, जाहि मे नेपाल आ आगूक यात्रा आ पर्यटन उद्योगक सतत विकासक वकालत आ संलग्नताक भूमिका अछि ।

full_article: Indian Army chief General Dhiraj Seth on Tuesday called on Nepal Prime Minister and defence minister Balendra Shah and discussed ways to strengthen military relations. He is on a three-day tour of Nepal.“The General paid a courtesy call on the Honourable Prime Minister of Nepal, during which he engaged in a warm and fruitful discussion on strengthening defence cooperation between the two countries,” Indian embassy in Nepal said on X on Tuesday.Gen Seth, who was given the honorary rank of General of the Nepali Army a day before, also visited the Nepali Army Command and Staff College in Shivpuri, where he shared his insights with the faculty and student officers on professional military education and contemporary security challenges.Speaking on “Evolving Dynamics of Modern Warfare and its Implications on Junior Leadership”, the Army chief highlighted the growing significance of technology, information and multi-domain operations in contemporary conflicts.Nepal’s leaders have traditionally attached importance to early engagement with New Delhi, reflecting the close political and economic relations between the neighbours. However, Nepal PM Shah has not undertaken any visit to India till now. Instead, foreign minister Shisir Khanal made back-to-back visits to New Delhi and Beijing in June.

title: Nepal, India to discuss cross-border security concerns tomorrow - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepal, India to discuss cross-border security concerns tomorrow  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Senior home ministry officials from Nepal and India will meet in Dehradun, India, on Thursday and Friday for talks on border management and a range of bilateral security concerns, amid heightened attention to security along the two countries’ open and porous border.

The 14th meeting of the India-Nepal Joint Working Group on Border Management comes in the wake of recent unrest and communal violence in Nepal’s Tarai-Madhesh region, which shares a long border with India.

Although Nepal’s security agencies have found no credible evidence of direct or indirect links between the unrest and individuals or groups operating from India, border security and other cross-border concerns are expected to feature prominently in the talks, a senior home ministry official told the Post.

“The discussions are expected to cover issues such as religious fundamentalism, the activities of third-country nationals who could potentially be involved in instigating unrest, and monitoring their movements,” said the official.

Anand Kafle, joint secretary at the home ministry who oversees the Security and Coordination Division, will lead the Nepali delegation at the two-day annual meeting.

The ministry officials say the agenda includes cross-border criminal activities, the entry and movement of third-country nationals, smuggling, drug trafficking from India into Nepal and illegal trade in arms and ammunition.

Circulation of counterfeit currency, information sharing between the security agencies of Nepal and India, border regulations, removal of encroachments in no-man’s land, and unauthorised trade are the other agenda.

Also on the agenda are Indian assistance to Nepali security agencies, information sharing, capacity building of Nepal’s security institutions, and Nepal’s request for India to recognise its national identity card as a valid travel document.

The two sides will also review decisions taken by lower-level security mechanisms involving chief district officers on the Nepali side and district magistrates on the Indian side, as well as the Armed Police Force and India’s Sashastra Seema Bal.

“Since 2010, we have discussed religious fundamentalism, the role of third-country nationals in instigating unrest, illegal border crossings and information sharing on related matters in every meeting. We expect similar discussions this time too,” the ministry official said.

“But we are not in a position to provide any concrete evidence to the Indian side that any group or individual was involved in instigating the unrest in the Tarai-Madhesh.”

Within Nepal’s security apparatus, however, there is some apprehension that certain individuals and groups operating in India and other third countries could have strong religious or other links that may have contributed to the recent unrest.

Issues concerning radical and religious fundamentalism, the activities of third-country nationals across the border and tightening border security have routinely featured in security meetings between the two countries, ranging from the home secretary level to meetings between chief district officers and district magistrates.

Nepal and India also have a permanent local-level mechanism, the Border District Coordination Committee (BDCC), to address security issues in border districts.

“In every security-related meeting, officials from both sides discuss the risks posed by third-country nationals, religious fundamentalism and radical elements, but we have hardly been able to do anything about them,” a former Nepal Police official said.

Some of the issues on the agenda are permanent, officials said. The meeting will also review progress made since the 13th meeting, held in Pokhara last year.

Since the Boundary Working Group and the Survey Officials Committee began meeting regularly, the mandate and work of these two boundary-related mechanisms have also occasionally featured in discussions.

In earlier meetings, officials discussed the repair and maintenance of border pillars, particularly in the absence of regular meetings of the two boundary-related mechanisms.

This time, too, officials are expected to discuss trans-border criminal activities; strengthening border infrastructure, particularly integrated check posts, roads and railway networks; empowerment and capacity building of various security-related institutions; and ways to strengthen cooperation in disaster risk reduction and management.

नेपाल आरू भारत केरऽ गृह मंत्रालय केरऽ वरिष्ठ अधिकारी सिनी के बैठक गुरुवार आरू शुक्रवार क॑ भारत केरऽ देहरादून म॑ सीमा प्रबंधन आरू द्विपक्षीय सुरक्षा केरऽ कई तरह के चिंता के बारे म॑ बातचीत करलऽ जैतै, जेकरा म॑ दूनू देश केरऽ खुला आरू छिद्रपूर्ण सीमा प॑ सुरक्षा प॑ अधिक ध्यान देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

सीमा प्रबंधन पर भारत-नेपाल संयुक्त कार्यदल के 14म बैसार भारत के संग लंबा सीमा साझा करय वाला नेपाल के तराई-मधेश क्षेत्र में हाल में अशांति आ साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा के बाद आबि रहल अछि.

गृह मंत्रालय केरऽ एगो वरिष्ठ अधिकारी न॑ पोस्ट क॑ बतैलकै कि भले ही नेपाल केरऽ सुरक्षा एजेंसी क॑ अशांति आरू भारत स॑ संचालित व्यक्ति या समूह के बीच प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष संबंध के कोय विश्वसनीय सबूत नै मिललऽ छै, लेकिन सीमा सुरक्षा आरू अन्य सीमा पार सरोकार के बात ई बातचीत म॑ प्रमुखता स॑ देखै के उम्मीद छै ।

अधिकारी नँ कहलकै, “चर्चा मँ धार्मिक कट्टरता, तेसरऽ देश के नागरिकऽ के गतिविधि जे संभावित रूप स॑ अशांति भड़काबै म॑ शामिल होय सकै छै, आरू ओकरऽ आवाजाही के निगरानी जैसनऽ मुद्दा शामिल होय के उम्मीद छै ।

सुरक्षा आ समन्वय प्रभाग के देखरेख करय वाला गृह मंत्रालय के संयुक्त सचिव आनंद काफ्ले दू दिवसीय वार्षिक बैसार मे नेपाली प्रतिनिधिमंडल के नेतृत्व करताह.

मंत्रालय के अधिकारी के कहनाय छनि जे एजेंडा मे सीमा पार सं आपराधिक गतिविधि, तेसर देश के नागरिक के प्रवेश आ आवागमन, तस्करी, भारत सं नेपाल मे नशा के कारोबार आ हथियार आ गोला-बारूद के अवैध व्यापार शामिल अछि.

नकली मुद्रा के प्रचलन, नेपाल आ भारत के सुरक्षा एजेंसी के बीच सूचना साझा करब, सीमा नियमावली, कोनो आदमी के जमीन पर अतिक्रमण के दूर करब, आ अनधिकृत व्यापार दोसर एजेंडा अछि.

संगहि एजेंडा मे नेपाली सुरक्षा एजेंसी कए भारतीय सहायता, सूचना साझा करब, नेपाल क सुरक्षा संस्थान क क्षमता निर्माण, आ भारत स नेपाल क आग्रह जे ओ अपन राष्ट्रीय पहचान पत्र कए वैध यात्रा दस्तावेज क रूप मे मान्यता देथि ।

दुनू पक्ष नेपाली पक्ष के मुख्य जिला अधिकारी आ भारतीय पक्ष के जिला मजिस्ट्रेट के संग-संग सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल आ भारत के सशास्त्र सीमा बाल के शामिल करय वाला निचला स्तरीय सुरक्षा तंत्र के फैसला के समीक्षा सेहो करत.

मंत्रालय के अधिकारी कहलनि जे, 2010 सं हम हर बैसार मे धार्मिक कट्टरता, अशांति, अवैध सीमा पार करय आ संबंधित मामला पर सूचना साझा करय मे तेसर देश के नागरिक के भूमिका पर चर्चा केलहुं अछि, एहि बेर सेहो एहने चर्चा के उम्मीद अछि।

“मुदा तराई-मधेश मे अशांति भड़काबय मे कोनो समूह वा व्यक्ति संलग्न छल, भारतीय पक्ष केँ कोनो ठोस प्रमाण देबाक स्थिति मे हम सब नहि छी।”

लेकिन नेपाल केरऽ सुरक्षा तंत्र के भीतर कुछ आशंका छै कि भारत आरू अन्य तेसरऽ देशऽ म॑ संचालित कुछ व्यक्ति आरू समूहऽ के धार्मिक या अन्य मजबूत संबंध होय सकै छै जेकरा स॑ हाल केरऽ अशांति म॑ योगदान होय ​​सकै छै ।

कट्टरपंथी आरू धार्मिक कट्टरता, सीमा पार के तीसरा देश के नागरिकऽ के गतिविधि आरू सीमा सुरक्षा क॑ कड़ा करै स॑ जुड़लऽ मुद्दा नियमित रूप स॑ दूनू देशऽ के बीच सुरक्षा बैठकऽ म॑ सामने ऐलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ गृह सचिव स्तर स॑ ल॑ क॑ मुख्य जिला अधिकारी आरू जिला मजिस्ट्रेट के बीच बैठक तक शामिल छै ।

नेपाल आ भारतमे सीमावर्ती जिल्लामे सुरक्षाके समस्या सम्बोधनके लेल स्थायी स्थानीय स्तरीय तंत्र सीमा जिल्ला समन्वय समिति (बीडीसीसी) सेहो अछि ।

नेपाल पुलिसक एकटा पूर्व अधिकारी कहलनि जे, सुरक्षा सं जुड़ल हर बैसार मे दुनू पक्षक अधिकारी तेसर देशक नागरिक, धार्मिक कट्टरता आ कट्टरपंथी तत्वक जोखिम पर चर्चा करैत छथि, मुदा हम सब शायदे एहि पर किछु क सकलहुं अछि।

अधिकारी सब कहलनि जे, एजेंडा मे किछु मुद्दा स्थायी अछि। एहि बैसार मे पिछला साल पोखरा मे भेल 13म बैसार क बाद स भेल प्रगति क समीक्षा सेहो कैल जाएत।

जब॑ स॑ सीमा कार्यदल आरू सर्वेक्षण अधिकारी समिति केरऽ नियमित बैठक शुरू होय गेलऽ छै, तब॑ स॑ सीमा स॑ जुड़लऽ ई दूनू तंत्र केरऽ जनादेश आरू काम भी बीच-बीच म॑ चर्चा म॑ भी आबी रहलऽ छै ।

पहिने के बैठकऽ म॑ अधिकारियऽ न॑ सीमा स्तंभऽ के मरम्मत आरू रखरखाव के बारे म॑ चर्चा करलकै, खास करी क॑ सीमा स॑ जुड़लऽ दूनू तंत्र के नियमित बैठक नै होला के कारण ।

एहि बेर सेहो अधिकारी लोकनि सं सीमा पार सं आपराधिक गतिविधि पर चर्चा करबाक उम्मीद अछि ; सीमा बुनियादी ढाँचा, विशेष रूप सं एकीकृत चेक पोस्ट, सड़क आ रेलवे नेटवर्क कें मजबूत करनाय; विभिन्न सुरक्षा सं संबंधित संस्थाक कें सशक्तिकरण आ क्षमता निर्माण; आ आपदा जोखिम कम करय आ प्रबंधन मे सहयोग कें मजबूत करय कें तरीका.

title: Govt steps up rescue, relief and repatriation of Nepalis abroad - The Rising Nepal
description: Govt steps up rescue, relief and repatriation of Nepalis abroad  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By A Staff Reporter,Kathmandu, Aug. 19: Minister for Foreign Affairs Shisir Khanal has said that the government is implementing effective initiatives for the rescue, relief and repatriation of Nepalis stranded abroad.

The government has allocated Rs. 150 million in the current Fiscal Year 2026/27 for the rescue, relief and repatriation of Nepali citizens stranded abroad. The 'Procedure for Administering the Budget Allocated for the Rescue, Relief and Repatriation of Nepali Citizens Stranded Abroad, 2083' prepared by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) for administering the budget is awaiting approval from the Ministry of Finance (MoF).

Responding to the questions raised in Parliament by lawmaker Ashika Tamang regarding the delayed repatriation of the body of Santosh Rai, a permanent resident of Jugedi in Dhunibesi Municipality of Dhading district, who died while undergoing treatment in Cambodia, on Tuesday, he updated the House about the procedure.

According to FM Khanal, feeling the need for a separate source of funding for rescuing Nepali citizens stranded abroad, the MoF was requested to make budgetary arrangements. The procedure was sent to the MoF on Friday.

“Once it is approved by the MoF, the Foreign Ministry will implement it. The delay was not because we were reluctant or unwilling to prepare the procedure. As this is a serious matter, we had to give careful consideration to where and under what circumstances the funds should be used,” he said.

According to him, the procedure proposes a maximum expenditure of Rs. 1.2 million per person to repatriate a stranded citizen of dead body.

FM Khanal said the procedure also contains limited provisions for cases in which Nepali citizens fall ill and require medical treatment. Rescue and repatriation efforts would proceed in accordance with the procedure once it receives approval from the MoF.

Clarifying the issue raised by lawmaker Tamang in line with the Speaker’s ruling, Minister Khanal said the government had made the necessary financial arrangements for the rescue of Nepali citizens abroad and the repatriation of their bodies.

Santosh Rai had died while undergoing treatment at Calmette Hospital in Cambodia on 14 May 2026. His body is currently being kept at a hospital in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. The Nepali Embassy in Bangkok had informed the government that approximately US$1,000 would be required to bring the body back to Nepal, including outstanding medical and mortuary charges and airfare.

Likewise, Minister Khanal said the repatriation of bodies and rescue of Nepali citizens who travel abroad legally, particularly those who obtain labour approval, is comparatively straightforward because they are insured through the Department of Foreign Employment. However, he said the rescue of Nepali citizens who travel abroad through irregular channels presents legal and financial complications.

He said the government must also consider whether using public funds to rescue citizens who have travelled abroad after becoming involved in activities prohibited by the government or contrary to the law could encourage illegal activities.

“The government has two major responsibilities — one is to protect its citizens, and the other is to ensure that money legally paid by taxpayers is used appropriately,” Minister Khanal said. “There are circumstances in which people need to be rescued on humanitarian grounds, but we must also seriously consider whether legally acquired public funds should be used in a way that could encourage unlawful activities.”

According to FM Khanal, the bodies of around 160 Nepali citizens have been repatriated to Nepal in the past four months alone. He also said around 860 Nepali citizens who had travelled to Cambodia on visit visas and were working in scam centres had been rescued and brought back to Nepal over a period of several months.

Plan to construct buildings for missions abroad

FM Khanal informed the House that the government plans to reduce expenditure on rent by constructing embassy and residential buildings on land already owned by Nepal’s diplomatic missions abroad. He said the government plans to gradually construct buildings for missions that already have their own land.

Minister Khanal made the remarks while responding to questions raised by lawmakers in the House of Representatives on Monday about the failure to construct buildings for Nepali missions despite land having been purchased years ago, resulting in substantial expenditure on rent.

He also said that Nepali missions abroad should have buildings that reflect Nepal’s own identity and representation.

According to Minister Khanal, Rs. 1.39 billion was spent on rent for Nepali missions abroad last year. This represented around 17 per cent of the total budget allocated to the MoFA.

He said land had been purchased for Nepali missions and ambassador's residences in places including Islamabad, Riyadh, Colombo, Kuala Lumpur, Muscat, Canberra and Beijing, but the necessary buildings had not yet been constructed. He said the main reason for delays behind construction was the lack of clear legal provisions governing the construction of public buildings abroad.

The Minister said amendments to the Public Procurement Act 2063 had established provisions allowing Nepali embassies and missions abroad, as well as other public bodies with offices overseas, to prepare the necessary procedures, obtain approval from the Public Procurement Monitoring Office (PPMO) and implement them.

With the legal framework now in place, the MoFA has begun advancing the process of constructing buildings for missions that already own land. The process has been initiated for chancery and residential buildings in Australia, Saudi Arabia and Thailand.

According to FM Khanal, a consultant has already been appointed to undertake architectural and engineering work and prepare a cost estimate for the construction of the Nepali Embassy building in Canberra.

He said work was under way to prepare the terms of reference (ToR) required to select a consultant to carry out architectural, design and engineering work and prepare a cost estimate for the construction of the Nepali Embassy and residential building in Bangkok.

Local staff at Nepali missions abroad

Likewise, FM Khanal informed the House of Representatives that local staff are appointed at Nepali missions abroad in accordance with a directive formulated a decade ago for the same.

A total of 374 local employees are currently working at Nepali diplomatic missions abroad, including 185 Nepali citizens and 126 foreign nationals.

Lawmaker Nishcal Rai had sought the number of Nepali and foreign local employees working at Nepali missions abroad and the financial burden they impose on the state.

According to FM Khanal, locally available personnel are hired on contract to assist diplomatic staff with day-to-day administrative, consular and other duties at Nepali missions abroad. He said hiring local employees, rather than sending additional staff from Nepal, was more cost-effective while also making operations easier and being practical from administrative and diplomatic perspectives.

Minister Khanal also said Rs. 911.73 million was spent on salaries for local staff in the FY 2025/26. He claimed that the number of local employees at Nepali missions was significantly lower than in other countries with large diaspora similar to Nepal’s.

"The Nepali missions in Abu Dhabi and Dubai in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), which is home to around 700,000 Nepalis, have a combined total of only 10 local employees. But Philippine mission has 75 local employees," he said.
